title.en: Charging and discharging of a capacitor

heading.en: Why does the charger LED fade slowly?

hook.en: Unplug some chargers and their LED glows for a second before fading out. A capacitor inside is discharging through a resistor, and the time it takes is set by R × C.
hook.kn: ಕೆಲವು ಚಾರ್ಜರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದಾಗ LED ಒಂದು ಕ್ಷಣ ಉರಿದು ಆರುತ್ತದೆ. ಒಳಗಿನ ಧಾರಕ ರೋಧಕದ ಮೂಲಕ ವಿಸರ್ಜನೆಯಾಗುತ್ತಿದೆ; ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಬೇಕಾದ ಕಾಲ R × C.

objectives.en: Write the charging and discharging equations
Define the time constant τ = RC
Calculate capacitor voltage at a given time

narration.en: Unplug some chargers and their LED glows for a second before fading out. A capacitor inside is discharging through a resistor, and the time it takes is set by R × C.
narration.kn: ಕೆಲವು ಚಾರ್ಜರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದಾಗ LED ಒಂದು ಕ್ಷಣ ಉರಿದು ಆರುತ್ತದೆ. ಒಳಗಿನ ಧಾರಕ ರೋಧಕದ ಮೂಲಕ ವಿಸರ್ಜನೆಯಾಗುತ್ತಿದೆ; ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಬೇಕಾದ ಕಾಲ R × C.

body.en: When a capacitor charges from a DC supply V through R, its voltage rises exponentially: $v_C = V(1 - e^{-t/RC})$, while the current falls: $i = (V/R) e^{-t/RC}$. The time constant $τ = RC$ is the time to reach 63.2 % of the final voltage. After about 5τ the capacitor is practically fully charged.
body.kn: R ಮೂಲಕ V ಆಕರದಿಂದ ಧಾರಕ ಆವೇಶಗೊಳ್ಳುವಾಗ ಅದರ ವಿಭವಾಂತರ ಘಾತೀಯವಾಗಿ ಏರುತ್ತದೆ, ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಾಲ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ τ = RC; ಅಷ್ಟು ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ 63.2 % ತಲುಪುತ್ತದೆ. ಸುಮಾರು 5τ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಆವೇಶ.

narration.en: When a capacitor charges from a DC supply V through R, its voltage rises exponentially: v_C = V(1 - e^{-t/RC}), while the current falls: i = (V/R) e^{-t/RC}. The time constant τ = RC is the time to reach 63.2 % of the final voltage. After about 5τ the capacitor is practically fully charged.
narration.kn: R ಮೂಲಕ V ಆಕರದಿಂದ ಧಾರಕ ಆವೇಶಗೊಳ್ಳುವಾಗ ಅದರ ವಿಭವಾಂತರ ಘಾತೀಯವಾಗಿ ಏರುತ್ತದೆ, ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಾಲ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ τ = RC; ಅಷ್ಟು ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ 63.2 % ತಲುಪುತ್ತದೆ. ಸುಮಾರು 5τ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಆವೇಶ.

body.en: A capacitor charged to V and discharged through R loses voltage exponentially: $v_C = V e^{-t/RC}$. After one time constant it falls to 36.8 % of V; after 5τ it is practically empty. The current flows in the opposite direction to the charging current.
body.kn: V ಗೆ ಆವೇಶಗೊಂಡ ಧಾರಕ R ಮೂಲಕ ವಿಸರ್ಜಿಸುವಾಗ vC = V e^(−t/RC). ಒಂದು τ ನಂತರ 36.8 % ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ; 5τ ನಂತರ ಬಹುತೇಕ ಖಾಲಿ.

points.en: At t = τ: 36.8 % of V remains
Discharge current is opposite to charging current

narration.en: A capacitor charged to V and discharged through R loses voltage exponentially: v_C = V e^{-t/RC}. After one time constant it falls to 36.8 % of V; after 5τ it is practically empty. The current flows in the opposite direction to the charging current.
narration.kn: V ಗೆ ಆವೇಶಗೊಂಡ ಧಾರಕ R ಮೂಲಕ ವಿಸರ್ಜಿಸುವಾಗ vC = V e^(−t/RC). ಒಂದು τ ನಂತರ 36.8 % ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ; 5τ ನಂತರ ಬಹುತೇಕ ಖಾಲಿ.

aim.en: Charge and discharge a capacitor through a resistor, plot voltage against time and read off the time constant.

narration.en: Charge and discharge a capacitor through a resistor, plot voltage against time and read off the time constant.

problem.en: A 100 µF capacitor charges through 10 kΩ from a 10 V supply. Find τ and the voltage after 1 s.

steps.en: It is practically full (≈ 9.93 V) after 5 s.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A 100 µF capacitor charges through 10 kΩ from a 10 V supply. Find τ and the voltage after 1 s.

problem.en: A 10 µF capacitor charged to 12 V discharges through 47 kΩ. Find τ and the voltage after one time constant.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A 10 µF capacitor charged to 12 V discharges through 47 kΩ. Find τ and the voltage after one time constant.

body.en: In one time constant a charging capacitor gains 63 % of what is left to gain; a discharging one keeps 37 %. The two numbers always add to 100. Five time constants and you are done.

narration.en: 63 up, 37 down. In one time constant a charging capacitor gains 63 % of what is left to gain; a discharging one keeps 37 %. The two numbers always add to 100. Five time constants and you are done.
Team quiz. Each team discusses and agrees on one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ತಂಡ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದೇ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒಪ್ಪಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the PUC board exam pattern.

points.en: τ = RC; charging reaches 63.2 % at t = τ.
points.kn: τ = RC; t = τ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಆವೇಶನ 63.2 % ತಲುಪುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: About 5τ to charge or discharge fully.

homework.en: Find τ for 220 kΩ and 4.7 µF, and how long the capacitor takes to charge fully.

narration.en: Recap. τ = RC; charging reaches 63.2 % at t = τ. Discharging leaves 36.8 % after one τ. About 5τ to charge or discharge fully.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. τ = RC; t = τ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಆವೇಶನ 63.2 % ತಲುಪುತ್ತದೆ. ಒಂದು τ ನಂತರ ವಿಸರ್ಜನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ 36.8 % ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಪೂರ್ಣ ಆವೇಶನ ಅಥವಾ ವಿಸರ್ಜನೆಗೆ ಸುಮಾರು 5τ.
